Requirements: R-12
Plan row: TS-6

## Given
A guest holds one marked book in the cart. The browser request POST /api/cart/merge is intercepted to answer 500 (P-merge500) and, in a second run, never to answer (P-mergetimeout).

## Steps
1. Sign in as the stand user on the login page.
2. Observe the page after sign-in; read the guest cart with the guest cookie (GET /api/cart).

## Then
1. After the failed merge the shopper sees what Q4 (with Q5) gives for a failed merge: a visible error text or the guest item still in the guest cart, for both P-merge500 and P-mergetimeout. A success-only outcome with the guest item gone and no text fails the case.
2. The page after sign-in is the one Q4 gives (not blank, not stuck on the login form).
